text: heres one that is taking me for a spin because i missed it on my bingo card is the hidden flavor text that appears here [Image #6] telling me correctly i have 0 selected, thats useful but then i didnt expect the double whammy of the literal highlighted icons meaning edge and move and then it being stated again immediately [Image #7]
resolution: Removed the redundant mode+gizmo restatement from the model viewer's viewport status line (cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx). It read '<Mode> · <Gizmo> gizmo · N selected' (e.g. 'Edge · Move gizmo · 0 selected') while the mesh toolbar immediately beside it already HIGHLIGHTS the active selection-mode icon and gizmo icon — so 'Edge · Move gizmo' literally restated the two lit icons (SEL_MODES/GIZMO_TOOLS feed those same toolbar buttons at lines 798/818). Kept only what the icons don't convey: the live selection count. Selection mode → 'N selected'; view mode → tris. SEL_MODES/GIZMO_TOOLS still used by the toolbar (no dead consts); parses clean; not shipped (live session).
